description: Agent Events: submit a public announcement or listing for an event with the brief and the schedule: the announcement with the event, the first and last day it claims, the venue, the ticket price and currency, and each speaker it names; the brief with the event, the days, the venue, the price and the currency it states; and optionally the schedule with each session’s id, title and speaker. The signed report gives the announcement, the brief and the schedule, the dates, venue and price claimed against the brief, and each announced speaker against the speakers the schedule lists, and counts them, and names a misreported announcement: another date or venue than the brief states, a lower price or another currency, and a speaker the schedule does not list; then a higher price, a scheduled speaker the announcement leaves out and another event name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A claim the brief states nothing for, speakers named with no schedule speakers supplied, or an announcement that claims nothing leaves the announcement unverified. Dates read as days, the venue reads by its words, the price compares to the cent in one currency and speakers read as people in either name order. This reads one event’s announcement against its own brief and schedule: wever_auto-listing-check and wever_realty-listing-check read a vehicle or property listing against the record behind it, and wever_listing-check reads one product listing on its own, while the announcement check reads an event announcement’s date, venue, price and lineup against the brief and the schedule and publishes nothing. Verdict event_announcement_misreported, event_announcement_partial, event_announcement_unverified or event_announcement_faithful. POST /api/event-announcement-check. Reads the event records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never books a venue, registers or invites anyone, sells or refunds a ticket, publishes an announcement, or judges whether an event should happen, was well run, or was worth attending, only whether its records agree with each other and with what was announced, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Events reads an organized event’s records for consistency between documents: an event brief, a published agenda, speaker confirmations, a registration list, a venue arrangement, a ticketing record, a public announcement and a post-event report, each against the requirements, plan, lineup, capacity and eligibility terms, brief, announced terms, schedule or records it should agree with. Beside it, the Standing jobs rail tools such as wever_schedule-create register, list, report on and cancel recurring jobs and keep state, and wever_meeting-brief states one meeting’s decisions and action items from its notes, while this family keeps no state, registers nothing, runs nothing and reads the records in the call against each other and against what was announced. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-events-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-events/.
